title: WTO | Open Day
content:
WTO Open Day provides an opportunity for the public to visit the home of the WTO, to learn more about the work of the organization and its staff, and to discover the
works of art in the WTO's headquarters in Geneva.
The most recent WTO Open Day was held on 9 June 2024.
